SCENE CONTEXT
NIGHT, an enormous field of discarded machines. Thousands of identical childcare units are
walking toward one small wrapped bundle at the centre of it.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
<<<f21c7439-445f-40c6-8d38-8c27e170ab94>>> — the childcare unit. EVERY FIGURE IN EVERY CUT IS THIS SAME MODEL.
100% matches the reference. Its appearance must not drift.
<<<dc8ce02d-0ce4-4b14-8417-59e6964f2559>>> — the small wrapped bundle. 100% matches the reference.

IT IS NIGHT THROUGHOUT. The only light is DYING AMBER FIRES burning low among the wreckage,
scattered across the field into the far distance. Everything beyond the firelight falls to
black. No daylight, no grey sky.

CUT 1 — 0.0s to 3.0s — LOW AERIAL
Looking STRAIGHT DOWN from about twenty metres. The bundle at the centre on cleared ground,
lit by fires close around it. A tight ring of units standing shoulder to shoulder around it,
heads down, motionless.

Beyond them, units WALKING INWARD from every direction, slow and heavy, many of them limping
or dragging.

The camera rises slowly.

CUT 2 — 3.0s to 5.5s — A FACE
HARD CUT TO GROUND LEVEL. Close on ONE childcare unit walking toward camera through the
wreckage, firelight raking across her. She fills the frame from the chest up.

HER FACE IS DAMAGED — synthetic skin split across one cheek, dry filament and pale alloy
beneath, grey dust spilling from the crack. The damage is completely dry.

SHE IS NOT LOOKING AT CAMERA. She is looking past it, ahead, toward something. She walks
steadily and does not stop. Others move past her on both sides, out of focus.

CUT 3 — 5.5s to 8.0s — ANOTHER FACE
HARD CUT. A different childcare unit, the same model, walking toward camera through the dark.
DAMAGED DIFFERENTLY — one side of her jaw missing, an eye socket empty, her scalp torn open
along the hairline. Also completely dry.

SHE IS ALSO NOT LOOKING AT CAMERA. Looking ahead, walking, unhurried, absolutely certain of
where she is going.

Behind and around her, dozens more moving in the same direction.

CUT 4 — 8.0s to 11.0s — HIGH AERIAL
HARD CUT TO STRAIGHT DOWN FROM MUCH HIGHER — a hundred and fifty metres. THE SCALE JUMPS
ENORMOUSLY.

The bundle is now a tiny warm point at the centre. The rings around it have become a dense
pale mass. And spreading out from it in every direction, THOUSANDS OF FIGURES — not scattered
but flowing, moving in LONG STREAMS AND RIVERS along the open paths between the heaps of
wreckage, all of them converging inward.

They are clearly moving. The whole field is in motion toward one point.

Fires scattered through it. The camera keeps rising.

CUT 5 — 11.0s to 15.0s — VERY HIGH AERIAL
HARD CUT TO STRAIGHT DOWN FROM FAR HIGHER STILL — four hundred metres or more. THE SCALE JUMPS
AGAIN.

The centre is now a small bright knot of light in an enormous black landscape. AND THE WHOLE
VISIBLE WORLD IS FULL OF THEM — rivers of figures running in from every edge of frame,
thousands upon thousands, converging from horizon to horizon. Long pale threads of movement
across a black field.

They are still coming. The frame is not big enough to hold where they are coming from.

The camera is still rising when the shot ends.

CAMERA
Cuts 1, 4 and 5 look PERFECTLY VERTICALLY DOWNWARD and rise slowly. They never tilt, turn or
pan. Cuts 2 and 3 are handheld at ground level, chest height, close, walking backwards ahead
of her. FOUR HARD CUTS. No dissolves, no slow motion.

STYLE AND PHOTOGRAPHY
Live action, not a render. Real drone footage at night on the aerials, with the small
instabilities that implies. Vintage uncoated glass, low micro-contrast, NOT clinically sharp.

Visible atmosphere between camera and ground — smoke and dust drifting through the firelight,
softening the middle distance and hiding the far edges.

The fires clip to pure white at their cores and bloom. THE UNLIT GROUND FALLS TO TRUE BLACK
with no recoverable detail. NO GLOBAL AMBIENT FILL, NO AMBIENT-OCCLUSION LOOK.

Heavy sensor noise in the shadows. Visible 35mm-scale grain, coarse and irregular. Chromatic
aberration at the frame edges. Natural vignette. Slight barrel distortion on the aerials.

NOTHING IS UNIFORM. Uneven spacing, broken rings, clusters, gaps where wreckage blocks the
ground. Some units fallen and lying where they fell.

ALL DAMAGE IS DRY — dry woven filament, corroded alloy, grey dust. No fluid, nothing red.

COLOUR: black, dying amber and dull orange firelight, rust, oxide, grey dust, pale garments.
Heavily desaturated, bleach-bypass, crushed blacks. No teal, no cyan, no blue, no neon.

AUDIO: wind across an open field. Distant fires. Thousands of slow dragging footsteps on metal
and debris, overlapping, from every direction, building across the shot. NO MUSIC. NO VOICES.

NO ON-SCREEN TEXT.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Five cuts. Four hard cuts. No dissolves.
Cuts 1, 4 and 5 look perfectly vertically downward and never tilt or turn.
EACH AERIAL IS DRAMATICALLY HIGHER THAN THE ONE BEFORE IT — twenty metres, then a hundred and
fifty, then four hundred. The scale must visibly jump at each cut.
Cuts 2 and 3 are ground-level close shots of two different childcare units with different
damage. Neither of them looks at camera.
Every figure in every cut is the same childcare unit model.
In cuts 4 and 5 the figures move in long streams and rivers, clearly walking, converging
inward from every direction.
The bundle stays a readable warm point at the centre of every aerial.
The convergence is unfinished when the shot ends.
All damage is dry — no fluid, nothing red.
No people appear — every figure is a machine.

SCENE CONTEXT
Night, storm ocean, torrential rain. The end of a fight he is losing until he isn't.

ACTIVE REFERENCE
<<<d8a564fb-13a3-48a8-b89d-68f55d5d0c0e>>> — a mountain of corroded machinery fused into one body, nine mismatched
heads on necks of different lengths and thicknesses, two heads hanging dead. 100% matches the
reference.

THE OCEAN
DEEP OPEN OCEAN IN A STORM. Large rolling swell moving continuously. Waves at near, middle
and far distances. WHITEWATER BREAKING violently against the machine's submerged body and
surging up its flanks. Spray torn off the crests. Visible moving horizon. THE MACHINE RISES
AND FALLS WITH THE SWELL and the camera floats with it. NOTHING IS STILL AND NOTHING IS FLAT.

THE FIGURE
A young man as a COMPLETE FULL-BODY SILHOUETTE — head, torso, both arms, both legs, all of him
in frame. Lean, fast, barefoot, soaked. HIS FACE IS NEVER VISIBLE at any point. NEVER a
disembodied limb.

OPENING STATE
He stands on a huge coil, arms spread for balance, facing a rearing hood a few metres away.
Grey storm haze, bright overcast, heavy rain. NO SEARCHLIGHT YET.

CUT 1 — 0.0s to 5.0s — THE STRIKE
THE HOOD SMASHES DOWN AT HIM. He throws himself sideways and rolls; the head hits the coil
where he stood and blows spray and torn plating into the air.

As the head RECOILS AND LIFTS, he sprints three strides and LEAPS ONTO IT, landing flat on
the top of the skull, both hands grabbing for anything. IT CARRIES HIM UP as it rises.

CUT 2 — 5.0s to 10.0s — THROWN
The head THRASHES violently, whipping side to side to shake him off. He is flung across it,
holding on with one hand, legs out in the air.

A SECOND HEAD DRIVES IN AT HIM FROM THE SIDE. He lets go, CATCHES THE TAIL as it sweeps past,
and SWINGS CLEAR on it in a wide arc through the rain — the second head smashing into the
first behind him.

He SLAMS DOWN onto the highest crown, hard, sliding, one hand flat on the wet plate to stop
himself going over the edge.

CUT 3 — 10.0s to 15.0s — THE ARRIVAL
The crown BUCKS under him. He stays low, riding it, one hand down.

AT 11.0s A HARD SEARCHLIGHT BEAM SWEEPS ACROSS THE WATER AND FINDS HIM — from high behind,
out of frame above. It pins him. THE GREY STORM HAZE FALLS AWAY INTO DARKNESS AROUND THE
BEAM, and from this moment the image is black with one hard shaft of light in it. He becomes
a solid black rim-lit silhouette.

11.5s — He gets ONE FOOT PLANTED FLAT. The bucking weakens.
11.8s — THE TAIL SWINGS INTO REACH. He catches it and hauls it up.

12.0s — HE PLANTS THE POSE. Standing foot set. THE OTHER LEG LIFTS HIGH AND CROSSES IN FRONT,
knee bent. The torso settles into three bends. THE ARM HOLDING THE TAIL RAISES HIGH ABOVE HIS
HEAD. The other arm extends out and slightly down.

AT THAT INSTANT THE MACHINE STOPS DEAD. All nine heads go still at once.

12.0s to 15.0s — HOLD. He does not move or break the pose. The machine does not move. ONLY
THE OCEAN, THE RAIN AND THE RAISED TAIL MOVE — the tail swaying once, slowly, under its own
weight. Whitewater still breaks at the base.

THE FRAME AT 15.0s IS THE POSTER.

CAMERA
Handheld, urgent, floating on the swell in cuts 1 and 2 — whipping with the action, struggling
to hold him. In cut 3 it settles and pulls back into the wide poster framing as the beam
arrives, then holds. THREE HARD CUTS. No slow motion.

STYLE AND PHOTOGRAPHY
THIS IS A LIVE-ACTION VFX PLATE, NOT A RENDER.

RAIN MUST STREAK, NOT DOT — motion-blurred vertical lines throughout. Foreground rain crosses
the lens. Droplets sit on the front element. DIRTY FLARE off the searchlight from 11.0s —
streaked and imperfect, never a clean star.

SPECULAR BREAKUP, NOT UNIFORM GLOSS on the wet corroded metal. LOW DYNAMIC RANGE, LIKE FILM —
the sky in cuts 1 and 2 and the beam in cut 3 clip to pure white; the machine's recesses and
the water fall to TRUE BLACK. NO GLOBAL AMBIENT FILL, NO AMBIENT-OCCLUSION LOOK.

Vintage uncoated glass, low micro-contrast. Genuine shadow noise. Visible 35mm-scale grain.
Chromatic aberration at the edges. Natural vignette.

COLOUR: cuts 1 and 2 — grey storm haze, white sky, black machine, whitewater, rust. From
11.0s — black, rust, wet grey, one hard white beam, faint amber fires far off. Heavily
desaturated, bleach-bypass, crushed blacks throughout. No teal, no cyan, no blue, no green,
no neon.

AUDIO: storm sea, torrential rain, enormous metal impacts, water displacement, his breathing.
Violent through the first eleven seconds. AT 12.0s THE VIOLENCE STOPS DEAD and only rain and
sea remain, much quieter. NO MUSIC — the flute goes in at the edit.

NO ON-SCREEN TEXT — the title composites afterwards.

POSITIVE LOCKS
He does NOT hold the final pose at the start. He is attacked, thrown and nearly loses for
twelve seconds.
The machine attacks him at least three times.
His whole body is in frame throughout. His face is never visible. No disembodied limbs.
The searchlight arrives at 11.0s and the image goes dark around it.
He reaches the full pose at 12.0s and holds it completely still until the end.
The machine is violent until 12.0s and completely still after it.
THE WATER IS A STORM OCEAN with swell, waves at multiple distances and breaking whitewater.
Never flat, never still, never mirror-like.
The camera floats with the swell and is never locked off.
Three hard cuts. No dissolves, no fades, no slow motion.

SCENE CONTEXT

reference.

<<<7ffb7ffb-d5d9-4a3a-88ce-72fda6557f3a>>> — HIS CLOTHING, AND IT NEVER CHANGES. A short wrapped undyed cotton lower
garment to just above the knee, hitched and knotted at the left hip. A plain sleeveless

HE IS FULLY CLOTHED THROUGHOUT. BOTH GARMENTS ARE HEAVY WITH WATER AND HANG CLOSE. NOTHING
BILLOWS, NOTHING LIFTS AND NOTHING CATCHES AIR, including in mid-air.

THE FIGURE
AN ADULT MAN IN HIS TWENTIES. Lean, fast, barefoot, soaked.

HE IS ALWAYS BETWEEN THE CAMERA AND THE LIGHT AND IS LIT ONLY FROM BEHIND, reading as one
solid dark shape with a hard bright rim. HE IS NEVER LIT FROM THE FRONT. HE IS SEEN WHOLE IN

THE OCEAN

12.0s — HE GETS TO HIS FEET on the pitching crown.

13.0s — HE LEAPS STRAIGHT UP, very high, arms rising, body extending, rising clear of the
machine into the beam and the rain. He hangs at the top of it for a moment, small and black
against the light.

14.0s — HE COMES DOWN AND DRIVES ONE HEEL INTO THE CROWN OF THE HEAD BENEATH HIM. His full
weight lands through that one foot.

THE IMPACT DISCHARGES. A HARD BURST OF WHITE-GOLD SPARKS bursts out from under his heel and
RUNS OUTWARD ALONG THE SEAMS of the housing, racing down the neck and out into the fused body,
lighting the corroded plates from within for a fraction of a second. Sparks spit and fall away

THE MACHINE CONVULSES ONCE, HARD — every head jerking at the same instant — AND THEN GOES
COMPLETELY STILL. All nine stop at once. The sparks die out along the seams from the far end

CUT 4 — 16.0s to 20.0s — THE HOLD
HARD CUT TO A WIDE, LOW, FROM FAR BACK — the full machine filling the centre and lower frame,
its heads spread and motionless, its extent running out of frame on both sides, the beam
coming down from high behind, AND HIM SMALL AT THE TOP.

HE IS ALREADY IN THE FINAL POSITION WHEN THE CUT BEGINS. All his weight on the foot he struck
with. THE OTHER KNEE UP HIGH, the lower leg crossed in front of the standing shin, foot turned
outward and held clear. Hips shifted over the standing foot, shoulders settled back the
opposite way. ONE HAND HOLDING THE RAISED TAIL STRAIGHT UP ABOVE HIS HEAD. The other arm out
sideways and slightly down, hand loose.

HE DOES NOT MOVE FOR FOUR SECONDS. He does not shift, wobble, step or lower his arm. The
machine does not move.

ONLY THE OCEAN, THE RAIN AND THE RAISED TAIL MOVE — the tail swaying once, slowly, under its
own weight. Whitewater still breaks at the base. The swell still lifts everything.

THE FRAME AT 20.0s IS THE POSTER.

CAMERA
Handheld, urgent, floating on the swell in cuts 1 and 2 — whipping with the action. In cut 3
it stays with him and rises as he leaps. In cut 4 it is locked and only floats gently on the
swell. FOUR HARD CUTS. No slow motion, no speed ramps, no dissolves.

THE SPARKS ARE PHOTOGRAPHIC, NOT GRAPHIC — individual points of light with real motion blur,
irregular in size and spacing, falling under gravity and going out at different times. They
throw a brief hard bounce onto the wet metal around the impact. NO glow effect, NO lens
distortion, NO energy beams, NO electricity arcs drawn as lines.

SPECULAR BREAKUP, NOT UNIFORM GLOSS on the wet corroded metal. LOW DYNAMIC RANGE, LIKE FILM —
the sky in cuts 1 and 2, the beam from 11.0s and the sparks all clip to pure white; the

EVERYTHING STOPS and only rain and sea remain, much quieter. NO MUSIC — the flute goes in at
the edit.

NO ON-SCREEN TEXT — the title composites afterwards.

POSITIVE LOCKS
HE IS FULLY CLOTHED IN EVERY CUT — a knotted wrapped garment to the knee and a sleeveless
vest, both heavy with water and hanging close. The cloth never billows or lifts.
HE IS ALWAYS BACKLIT AND NEVER LIT FROM THE FRONT.
He is seen whole from head to feet in every cut, with space around him.
He does NOT hold the final position at the start.
He leaps high at 13.0s and comes down heel-first onto the head at 14.0s.
The impact throws white-gold sparks that run outward along the seams and fall away into the
rain.
The machine convulses once and then goes completely still. It does not move again.
He is already in the final position when cut 4 begins, and holds it completely still.
THE WATER IS A STORM OCEAN with swell, waves at multiple distances and breaking whitewater.
Never flat, never still, never mirror-like.
The camera floats with the swell in cuts 1 to 3 and is locked in cut 4.
Four hard cuts. No dissolves, no fades, no slow motion.

SCENE CONTEXT
Clandestine phone footage. A man walks down the centre aisle of a large institutional ward,
filming secretly with the phone held low at his side. No people are present.

ACTIVE REFERENCE
<<<afb816e8-d7fe-4351-b285-381d5397768a>>> — the ward. Seamless off-white composite walls, seamless pale resin floor,
concealed cove lighting with no visible fittings, two long rows of closed waist-height
off-white moulded units with solid opaque white domes, one moulded off-white chair beside
each. 100% matches the reference for WHAT the room contains.

CRITICAL — THE REFERENCE SUPPLIES THE ROOM, NOT THE PHOTOGRAPHY
The reference plate is a clean tripod photograph. THIS SHOT IS THE OPPOSITE OF THAT. Take the
architecture, the units, the chairs and the lighting from the reference, and then photograph
them badly, on a phone, while walking.

FRAMING — DELIBERATELY POOR
VERTICAL 9:16. THE PHONE IS HELD LOW, at hip height, angled slightly upward, in one hand at
his side. He is not looking at the screen.

THE FRAME IS TILTED five to eight degrees and never levels. The composition is careless — the
top third of the frame is wasted on blank ceiling and cove light, the units and chairs sit low
in the bottom half, and the centre of the aisle is off-centre. NOTHING IS COMPOSED.

CAMERA
He is WALKING FORWARD at a normal pace down the centre aisle. Heavy vertical bounce with each
step. The rows of units and chairs slide past on both sides. The tilt drifts and worsens.

THE AUTOFOCUS HUNTS BADLY — the whole image pulsing soft and sharp repeatedly as the distance
to everything keeps changing.

ACTION
He walks the length of four or five units. The row recedes ahead of him into gloom. At around
3.5s he swings the phone slightly toward the units on the right, ALMOST getting a clear look
at one, then it slides out of frame as he keeps walking. He never stops.

EXPOSURE — THE PHONE CANNOT HANDLE THIS ROOM
The cove light BLOWS OUT COMPLETELY to featureless pure white along both walls, blooming and
smearing. The auto-exposure HUNTS AND REBALANCES visibly two or three times as he moves,
the whole image stepping brighter then darker. The undersides of the units and the far end of
the room crush to solid black with no detail.

AUDIO
Room tone. The soft rumble of air handling. His own footsteps and clothing rustle, very close
to the mic. DISTANT CRYING FROM MANY SOURCES ACROSS THE ROOM, thin, overlapping, unattended,
coming from every direction and continuing without pause. NOT ONE ADULT VOICE ANYWHERE. No
music score.

STYLE
PHONE FOOTAGE, NOT CINEMATOGRAPHY. Heavy digital sensor noise. Visible compression artefacts
and blocking in the dark areas and around the blown highlights. Aggressive digital sharpening.
Strong rolling-shutter skew and wobble on every step. Motion blur on the passing units. Flat,
ugly and real.

COLOUR: warm off-white, bone, pale grey, faint amber in the cove. Drained and institutional.
No teal, no cyan, no blue, no neon.

NO ON-SCREEN TEXT, no interface, no recording indicators, no timecode.

POSITIVE LOCKS
The frame is vertical 9:16 and TILTED throughout — it never levels.
The phone is held low at hip height and angled up. No phone or device is visible in frame.
He is walking continuously and never stops.
The top third of the frame is wasted on blank ceiling.

Her run is heavy, uneven and laboured — not athletic. Short choppy strides with flat heavy foot contact, torso pitched forward against the weight on the rope, shoulders visibly uneven because one arm is loaded and the other is clamped to her body, and a small hitch or stagger in the rhythm on every second or third step as the pain catches her. No free arm swing. She is moving as fast as a badly injured person can move, which is not very fast.

She is frightened and does not hide it. Eyes wide and darting, brows drawn hard together, mouth open, breathing in fast shallow ragged pulls with visible vapour. Sweat stands at her hairline and temples and runs down through the rain on her face — the sheen of physical effort layered over the wet, her skin flushed with exertion at the cheeks and throat. Her jaw works. She never looks at camera. Pore-level skin realism, catch-lights in both eyes.
